text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!
So this is what a big-city plushie looks like...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Freshly picked really makes a difference in freshness, huh!
Back home, so many of 'em are faded..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you very much.
I'll cherish it and put it on display!
